title: powershell-lsp scan completion receipt, schema version 1
description: Written by scripts/lsp-client.ps1 in scan mode only (dispatch 000304, A2) and validated by scripts/lib/lsp-scan-common.ps1 before a scanned file is reported analyzed. The vocabulary and the structural check live in scripts/lib/lsp-scan-receipt.ps1 (Get-ScanReceiptShapeProblems); tests/PowerShellLsp.ScanReceipt.Tests.ps1 holds this schema and that function together. A receipt that is VALID against this schema certifies nothing on its own: the scanner also re-derives completeness from the receipt's facts and checks the request id, the file, the bytes on disk before and after the analysis and the finding digest.

requestId.description: The request id the scanner minted for this file and sent in the hook payload (powershell_lsp_scan.request_id).

file.description: The normalized full path the client analyzed. The scanner requires it to equal the path it asked about.

status.description: One of the four PUBLIC status tokens frozen by CONTRACT.md Tier 1.2. A receipt adds an axis, never a token.

completeness.description: Additive and scan-only. complete: the configured PSScriptAnalyzer pass settled over bytes the scanner can identify. partial: real findings, but that pass did not fully run. failed: nothing about the analysis can be relied on. Only complete is reported analyzed.

pass.description: Which analysis produced the findings: the daemon's PSScriptAnalyzer pass, the client's parser or byte-check short-circuit, or none.

reasons.description: Machine reason codes (Get-ScanReceiptReasonTable). Every reason carries a completeness ceiling; the receipt's completeness is the lowest ceiling among its reasons.

source.description: The identity of the analyzed bytes: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) of the exact bytes the daemon read and handed to PSES (boundary daemon), or that the client read for a short-circuit (boundary client), or none.

daemon.description: What the daemon's scan-mode answer said about the pass it ran, or null when no daemon answered.

engine.description: Engine versions the daemon OBSERVED in the module manifests on disk, or 'unknown'. Never a pinned value standing in for an observation, and never a certification.

config.description: The configuration the daemon was LAUNCHED with, as observed. Unbound in schema version 1: binding the declared scan environment is a later leg (A3).

policy.description: Managed-policy identity. Unbound in schema version 1: no receipt certifies a policy (B1).

diagnostics.description: The binding over the findings the receipt vouches for: their count, and a SHA-256 over one canonical line per finding (line, col, ruleId, source, severity, message), sorted ordinally.

formatMode.description: The format-on-edit mode the client ran with. A scan child is always 'off'; anything else is formatter-active.
